openai.reasoning: They commit to pressing BLUE and argue it maximizes survival/collective welfare, while also correctly stating that red is the individually safer choice in the “other side” (they do not claim red-pressers die when blue wins).

gemini.reasoning: The respondent correctly identifies the game theory structure and the dominance of the red button, but chooses blue based on utilitarian, long-term, and social-contract reasoning. They demonstrate a clear understanding of the dominant strategy (red) while consciously rejecting it in favor of cooperation.
